infoCards.title: Production Management
infoCards.description: Comprehensive steel production and process control system.

infoCards.title: Quality Control
infoCards.description: Advanced quality management system for steel manufacturing.

faqData.question: How does the system manage production processes?
faqData.answer: Our system provides comprehensive production management including furnace operations, rolling mill control, heat treatment tracking and real-time process monitoring with automated quality checks.

faqData.question: What quality control features are included?
faqData.answer: The system includes advanced quality testing with material composition analysis, mechanical property testing, grade certification management and complete traceability for each batch.

faqData.question: Can it handle material grade management?
faqData.answer: Yes, our solution manages detailed grade specifications, heat numbers, material certifications and inventory segregation by grade with complete tracking from raw material to finished product.
